prompt:
Subject:
Maid figure in afternoon light

Main Figure:
One adult woman wearing a black and white classical maid-style dress in a wood-toned interior with large windows. A thigh-up portrait kneeling with both arms on a wooden table, looking back toward the camera in the back left.

Person/Expression:
Small oval face with a thin jaw, large dark brown almond-shaped eyes, thin well-groomed eyebrows, small nose, glossy pale pink lips. Looking at the camera over the shoulder with a quiet expression, lips slightly parted. Dark brown hair nearly black tied in a messy bun high on the back of the head, with straight thin bangs and long strands along the cheeks. Soft eyeliner and thin blush, bright natural skin.

Clothing/Pose:
A sleeveless mini dress made of sheer black tulle, with white organza ruffled shoulder decorations, white borders on the chest and back, a large white bow on the back, and a white translucent apron tied at the waist. White ruffled headdress, white lace-top over-knee socks. Kneeling on the floor, pulling the hips to the right of the screen and leaning the upper body forward, overlapping both forearms and hands on the table.

Background/Light:
Honey-colored wooden table and a small glass vase with faint dried flowers on the left, a bentwood chair on the right. Behind is a large window with a dark wooden frame and glass doors, with blurred city buildings and a balcony outside. Warm soft main light coming from the window at the top left illuminates the face, shoulders, arms, and white ruffles, casting long shadows on the floor through the black tulle.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. A close-up portrait taken from a camera at about the same height as the person's waist, with a very slight high-angle shot from the rear diagonal. The person is placed largely from the center to the right, capturing from above the head to the bent knees and white socks, with the lower right leg cut off at the screen edge. The table top is placed diagonally from the bottom left to the center, focus on the face and upper body, with the exterior blurred with a shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic live-action photograph. Precisely depicts the translucent tulle, white organza ruffles, ribbons, lace, wood grain, and fine hair translucent in the backlight. A quiet and elegant afternoon atmosphere centered on black, white, and warm wood brown.

Negative:
Do not make it a front-facing standing pose; do not change the black and white sheer maid outfit or the large white bow on the back.
